blocks.text: What’s your vibe? Bold and fearless? Sweet with a little spice? Cool and effortlessly chill? Whatever it is, XONARA says there’s a Bonchon flavor to match. Rising P-Pop girl group XONARA serves their own flavor to the table in the latest campaign ad as the newest ambassadors of Bonchon, the original Korean chicken favorite of Filipinos. This collaboration brings together Bonchon’s signature Korean-inspired taste and XONARA’s fresh P-pop energy, encouraging individuality through flavor and self-expression among the young Filipinos. In their latest Bonchon EAT 7 video ad, the seven-member group shows off what makes each of them uniquely XONARA. From Eurekah’s […]...
